title: EF02-D exact-conversation Brain Wake
owner: EF02-D completion event and conversation bridge
objective: Khi một action/batch kết thúc, đưa thông báo có chứng cứ vào đúng ChatGPT chat đã tạo yêu cầu, Brain có thể đọc kết quả mà không phải Human tự chuyển artifact.

design.producer: EF02 final result only; immutable event_id, action/batch/run IDs, source and artifact refs, delivery state
design.transport: project-owned bounded bridge only through an explicitly supported/authenticated channel; no invented ChatGPT conversation write API
design.binding: consented exact originating chat binding, checked against completion event, no token/cookie exposure in GitHub logs
design.receipt: Do not mark wake delivered until exact chat ack or observed supported chat delivery; issuer comment alone is not proof
design.idempotency: same event and chat binding cannot deliver duplicate wake
design.fallback: GitHub Issue/Action artifact remains the reliable read-only handoff when exact-chat channel is unavailable
design.optional_native_continuation: separate from wake delivery; Brain autonomy/dispatch never inferred

acceptance: With a real supported conversation endpoint and explicit binding, one completed EF02 action delivers one verifiable message into the originally bound chat; wrong/stale chat and duplicate event rejected.
If platform channel cannot post to exactly that chat, status remains UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN, GitHub feedback persists and no fake wake success.
No new executor invocation, candidate mutation, permissions bypass or automatic Brain dispatch is introduced by a wake event.
non_goals: Proactive ChatGPT wake claimed from GitHub comments alone
Use AIOS-Renew local wake implementation or credentials by default
